<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/audits/policy-compliance-scan/start/{ScanType}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Initiates a full system-wide policy compliance scan across all audit policies and assets. This operation triggers a comprehensive evaluation of all active audit policies, checks asset compliance against all policies, reconciles schedule assignments, and updates compliance status records throughout the system. The scan type parameter allows selection of different scan modes (typically 'FullScan' for complete system evaluation). This is a resource-intensive operation typically run during maintenance windows or when significant policy or asset changes require a complete compliance refresh.

**Workflow Example:**
1. Determine the appropriate scan type (typically 'FullScan' for complete system evaluation)
2. Initiate the scan using this endpoint with the scan type parameter
3. Review the returned results showing compliance metrics and status updates for all policies

**Response:**
Returns a list of policy compliance scan results showing detailed metrics for each audit policy processed, including asset counts, status updates, verification results, and compliance statistics.
